en.headline: ASD demands urgent lift repairs at Queen Mary Hospital new clinical block
en.dek: Only four of 28 lifts are operating in Clinical Block 1; the Architectural Services Department has ordered the contractor to complete rectification by the fourth quarter and reserved the right to claim damages.
body: The Architectural Services Department has directed the main contractor and the lift subcontractor for Queen Mary Hospital’s Clinical Block 1 to complete outstanding rectification works as soon as possible, with completion targeted within the fourth quarter of this year.

Reports indicated that of the 28 lifts installed by Anlev Elevator, only four were currently usable. The building, which reached substantial completion last year, has not yet begun providing clinical services because final testing, acceptance and defect rectification of the lifts remain incomplete.

A joint reply from the Architectural Services Department, the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department and the Hospital Authority confirmed that installation and operation had not yet met contractual requirements. The government said it would reserve the right to pursue claims for losses and impacts arising from the delay. Electrical and Mechanical Services Department records showed multiple reported lift faults involving the same contractor over the past year, including incidents that trapped people.

zh.headline: 建築署責成瑪麗醫院新大樓承建商盡早完成升降機執修
zh.dek: 臨床大樓1共28部升降機目前只有4部可用，建築署已責成總承建商及分判商盡快完成執修，預算今年第四季內完成，並保留追究權利。
body: 建築署已責成總承建商和負責瑪麗醫院「臨床大樓1」升降機工程的分判商，盡早及妥善完成有關執修工作，按現時進度預算今年第四季內完成。
有報道指大樓內28部升降機目前只有4部能運作，過去一年曾有多次故障，包括急墜導致職員被困。建築署、機電工程署及醫院管理局聯合回覆表示，建造工程去年大致完成，惟部分升降機工程仍處於最後測試、驗收及執漏階段，大樓尚未提供臨床服務。
發言人指出，安裝和運作尚未能夠達到合約訂明的運作要求，政府會就工程延誤引致的損失及影響保留追究權利。機電署網上資料顯示，過去一年有多宗涉及同一升降機承建商「安力電梯有限公司」的故障記錄。
